title: Ghost citation
content: A ghost citation happens when an AI answer uses your page as a linked source while the answer text leaves your brand's name out.

meta.why: Your page contributed to the answer, and a reader who skips the link does not see your company's name.
meta.example: A domain is cited in 10 sampled answers and the brand is named in 4 of them, so 6 are ghost citations, a ghost citation rate of 60%.
meta.check: Divide the answers that cite your domain without naming your brand by the answers that cite your domain, and multiply by 100 to get a ghost citation rate.
meta.limitation: We count a brand as named when the answer text contains the company name or a product name, and a tool that matches names by another rule produces a different count.
meta.sources: Animalz: AEO glossary | https://animalz.co/blog/aeo-glossary | Industry glossary
